_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services, by designing and selling hardware, and by delivering relevant online advertising to a global customer audience'; 'Our increasing focus on devices and services presents execution and competitive risks': 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Business model competition': 'Some companies compete with us using an open source business model'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins' (its own FY2012 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: Microsoft's own FY2012 10-K, under 'Our increasing focus on devices and services presents execution and competitive risks.', says 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers. Pricing and delivery models are evolving.' and 'These costs may reduce the operating margins we have previously achieved.' It competes with cloud services of its own: 'We are devoting significant resources to develop and deploy our own competing cloud-based software plus services strategies.' The stock trades at 13.4x FY13E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of Microsoft's licensed software specifically.

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services, by designing and selling hardware, and by delivering relevant online advertising to a global customer audience'; 'Our increasing focus on devices and services presents execution and competitive risks': 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Business model competition': 'Some companies compete with us using an open source business model'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins' (its own FY2012 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.51x; -4% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.31; conservative 2yr +26%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -24.2%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-5.2%/yr (Q1 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.6%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2012-12-14) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.51x (55.2% downside to Bear $12 / +108.9% upside to Bull $56) | Adj composite 2.38 vs market 2.07: gap +0.31 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | -4% above the EPP floor $28 (14x FY13E $2.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +26.4% total (+13.2%/yr) | At 13.4x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $35 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; unearned revenue +25.1% in Q1 FY13, forward revenues -8% (no Q2 FY13 revenue guide, Q1 FY13 revenue ex-currency); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
